pages.text: A Parchtear is an Arcane Gem formed from a black-spectrum piece of $(l:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in a pendeloque cut.$(br2)When activated, the Parchtear destroys a radius 1 cuboid area of fluid. If you are sneaking, it instead destroys a single block of fluid. Each fluid block destroyed consumes a point of charge.$(br2)Once fluid has been destroyed, other fluid is blocked from flowing into the same space for ten seconds.$(br2)To recharge a dun Parchtear, place it in the bucket voiding slot of a $(l:items/devouring_charm)Devouring Charm$().
